title: LidarDM: Generative LiDAR Simulation in a Generated World
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: LiDAR point cloud sequences (4D LiDAR video) raycast from a generated 3D scene composed with generated dynamic actors

control_signal.value: traffic layout at t=0: HD map layout rasterized into a segmentation map (5 map classes) plus actor boxes and ego position

control_mechanism.value: Map latent conditions a latent diffusion model for the static scene, sampled with classifier-free guidance; actors fitted to layout boxes; trajectories from an extended Waymax simulator; raycasting

base_model.value: Latent diffusion UNet with SDF scene VAE and map VAE; GET3D and AvatarClip for actors; Waymax for trajectories; NKSR for pseudo ground truth; UNet raydrop model

datasets.value: KITTI-360 for unconditional generation; Waymo Open (HD maps) for conditional generation and downstream tests

metrics.value: MMD and JSD on BEV occupancy; ICP energy, outlier percentage, Chamfer distance for temporal consistency; detection mAP; Wasserstein distance for intensity; planner L2 and collision rate

controllability_evidence.value: CenterPoint on generated LiDAR gets 56.4% vehicle mAP vs 59.7% on real LiDAR; mAP agreement with raw scan up to 81.1%; Chamfer distance 0.17 vs 0.39 for sequence-diffusion baseline

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop generation (accumulated over 90 frames shown); generated data is used to pretrain a planner, not rolled out interactively

notes: Simulator-style pipeline with composed generated world; control is the initial layout, not an ego action. No limitations section in packet.
